newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Prompt SIMEX Brent trades up on good technicals.
newsitem.headline: Prompt SIMEX Brent trades up on good technicals.

text.p: SIMEX June Brent crude futures extended its gains at midday with July traded 11 cents firmer from its last London's close, brokers said on Friday.
July was last traded at $18.75 with a total of 50 lots traded.
Levels closed well in London and New York, with June breaking the $18.50 per barrel support, said Tom James at Credit Lyonnais Rouse.

He added that while crude had seen some good recovery recently, products were lagging behind. He said it was good to seen that gasoline has finally woken up and help with the recovery. Technicals are good, he said.
Gasoline futures for June rose 1.58 cents a gallon to $62.50 cents on ACESSS sessions.
He expected heating oil to add to the support as temperatures in U.S rise and potentially pushed crude futures higher later Friday.
